title: 【收藏向】优选百元价位chaser pro 28c外胎
notes: Owner post (2025-09-02): two Chaser Pro 28C tires bought on Pinduoduo for CNY 105 measured 205 g and 209 g (a friend's weighed about 230 g); labelled 80-115 psi; about 30 mm wide at 95 psi on a 19 mm internal front rim. No road test yet. Commenters: the crown is thin; weights vary between samples.
